title: From Invoice to Cash: Breaking Down Silos in Financial Operations
summary: Key Takeaways Invoice-to-cash is the path from a finished sale to applied bank funds: invoice out, cash in, reconciled. Three stages carry the load: invoice creation, payment collection, and cash application. Each one is a spot where money moves or stalls. Manual invoice keying still runs at 86% of SMEs, 73% of mid-sized firms, and 35% of enterprises. Every keystroke seeds a downstream error. Around 93% of companies deal with late payments regularly, and that drains working capital right at the collection stage. Nobody agrees on where the cycle even begins. Some vendors scope it narrowly; others treat it as cross-functional. Run invoice-to-cash as one connected flow, not a relay race between disconnected tools, and you get the strongest results. Errors at invoice creation poison everything after. Accurate billing is the foundation, full stop. What “invoice-to-cash” actually means
